defect.now: width read from the scale table's own trailing extent (scale_spec.shape[1], else 1)
defect.shipped_symptom: ROM wafer refused: EMBED_LOOKUP output view is (32, 24, 1); expected (768, 8)
defect.why_it_hid: The reduced regression vehicle has head_dim 32 over a 32-element quantisation block, so its table scale really is [rows, 1] and the literal was correct there.  The shipped release has head_dim 256 over the same block and so carries 8 scales per row.  A constant that is right on the only vehicle under test is invisible.

gate_the_reduced_vehicle_is_unmoved.claim: The fix derives the width instead of asserting it, so on a vehicle whose table scale is [rows, 1] it computes the same 1 and the artifact cannot move.  Proved by rebuild, not by construction alone.

models_structurally_out_of_reach: Qwen3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash do not enter this front end -- the edited function is export_deepseek_v41_kernel_graph -- so no shipped digest of theirs is reachable from this change, independently of any rebuild.
purpose: Show what the Engram row-scale width fix moves and what it cannot move.  The front end declared a hardcoded scale width of 1 for EMBED_LOOKUP's gathered row-scale plane, with a comment asserting the table scale is [table_rows, 1].  That holds only when an Engram row is one block wide.
